outputs: retrieval-augmented generation outputs for fact-checking and question answering

changes_made.explanation: Normalized task names to title case and merged duplicate 'question answering' entries. Added 'Natural Questions' dataset mentioned in Appendix A.9.
Simplified metric variants to base forms (NDCG and Exact Match) following normalization guidelines.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The LLMs mentioned (Llama-3-8B-Instruct) are used as generation models, not evaluators.
No human evaluation of generated outputs was conducted. The paper only uses simulated human experts for retrieval experiments.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) evaluation, specifically evaluating retrieval quality and its impact on downstream NLG tasks (question answering and fact-checking). The main contribution is the Mixture of Retrievers (MoR) framework for improving retrieval performance. NLG evaluation is secondary to the retrieval evaluation focus.
